articles.title: This Plastic Eats Itself in Just 6 Days!
articles.summary: Scientists made a 'living plastic' that self-destructs in 6 days without leaving nasty microplastics. They hid sleepy bacteria inside, then woke them up with warm broth to eat the plastic. A wearable electrode made from it vanished in two weeks!

articles.title: Watch History: India's First Private Rocket Blasts Off!
articles.summary: Skyroot Aerospace's Vikram-1, India's first privately built orbital rocket, launches July 18. It's as tall as a 7-story building and can carry 770 pounds to space. Watch live as it carries a robotic arm for grabbing space junk and even a tiny gold rocket!

articles.title: This Camera Sees Invisible Particles in 3D!
articles.summary: Scientists built a camera that can track ghostly particles like neutrinos in 3D inside a big block of special plastic. It uses a trick from light field cameras—like having thousands of tiny lenses—to see where faint flashes come from. No more millions of tiny cubes!
